svg.aria-label: The Instinct composition flow in two bands: the top band is the question in — the same typed question runs Reflex's modelless engine first, and a confident fused-gate answer returns in microseconds with the specialist never paid; on abstain the bottom band takes over — top-k prune keeps the candidates, the sealed per-domain specialist scores them, an H1 cascade or H2 prior fusion calibrates the pick, and the answer ships with a decision receipt — while arsenal.toml, the only selection surface, hot-swaps registered arms monotonically
